title: JyGlobalVST Roaming Settings
description: User-portable preferences at %AppData%\Roaming\JyGlobalVST\settings.json (FR-022k). Forward-compatible: unknown top-level fields MUST be preserved on save (round-trip), unlike presets where unknown fields are rejected on import.

custom_scan_paths.description: Additional VST3 directories beyond the two default paths in FR-005.

update_check_endpoint_url.description: HTTPS-only. Per FR-022n: only hit when user explicitly invokes 'Check for updates…'.

validation_rules: FR-022k: schema-versioned, JSON, forward-compatible — preserve unknown fields on save.
Invalid default_buffer_size falls back to 256 with a non-modal notification.
